meaning:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.9.26;
father of: Gaal (H1603)
§ Ebed = "servant"
1) father of Gaal in the time of the judges
2) son of Jonathan and one of the sons of Adin who returned from exile with Ezra

elsewhere.note: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
